fluid_pipe_csr_materialization.index_math: For node n, outgoing directed connections occupy ConnectionCsrDestinations[ConnectionOffsets[n]..ConnectionOffsets[n+1]). The first pass counts degrees in ConnectionWriteCursor[n], prefix-sums offsets, then reuses ConnectionWriteCursor[n] as the per-node write head. The solve loop reads contiguous spans per node and skips neighbor <= nodeIndex to preserve the previous undirected transfer semantics over symmetric connections.
